Standardize a grouping tool's output for evaluation

prepare_grouping_table.Rd

Reduces a feature-level grouping result to the columns used by evaluate_grouping: feature_name, group, mz and rt. The grouping tool must have been run on the same feature table as MS1Match; this function only renames columns and cannot map features between different feature tables.

Usage

prepare_grouping_table(
  x,
  group_col,
  feature_col = "feature_name",
  mz_col = NULL,
  rt_col = NULL,
  rt_unit = c("sec", "min"),
  unassigned = c("0", "")
)

Arguments

x

data.frame with one row per feature.

group_col

Name of the column holding the group / cluster id.

feature_col

Name of the column holding the feature id (same ids as in the feature table MS1Match was run on). Plain numbers (1, 2, ...) are converted to FT0001, FT0002, ..., as in read_feature_table. Default "feature_name".

mz_col

Name of the m/z column. Needed to verify that the tool used the same feature table as MS1Match.

rt_col

Optional name of the retention-time column.

rt_unit

Unit of rt_col: "sec" (default) or "min". Minutes are converted to seconds.

unassigned

Values of group_col that mean "not grouped" (in addition to NA). Default c("0", "").

Value

data.frame with columns feature_name, group (character, NA = unassigned), mz and rt.
